tools.name: search_products
tools.description:
Search products for a buyer intent. Returns ranked candidates with price, availability and product_id.
    Call get_product(product_id) before quoting a specific variant. Prices in major units (USD).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Live details for one product: variants, price, stock status, checkout links.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description:
Start a purchase. v0 returns the merchant's checkout link for the chosen variant plus a Kaupia
    checkout_id. Keep the checkout_id and call report_outcome later so the order is covered and ranked.

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report what happened to a checkout: placed | delivered | wrong_item | late | refunded | failed.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description:
Delivered price for one variant to a US zip code: item + the store's own shipping rate for that address +
    estimated sales tax, plus the delivery estimate. Nothing is bought. Use it to compare real totals across stores.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description:
Order through Kaupia. customer = {name, email, address1, address2?, city, state, zip, phone?} (US only).
    The user pays Kaupia the delivered price at pay_url (Stripe); the participating merchant fulfills directly for the
    user; late, wrong or missing = refund. Confirm item, address and total w

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Status of an order placed through Kaupia (received → paid → placed → shipped → delivered) with tracking.

tools.name: shop_scorecard
tools.description: Per-shop outcome stats collected through Kaupia (delivered vs problems).

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "place_order" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
